arguments.prompt:
Edit the supplied exact owned-project Mourning Dove image to create exactly ONE closed-eye blink drawing of the SAME bird in the SAME pose. Change only the visible eyelid/eye region as closely as possible. This is an image edit, not a request for a newly composed bird, a head turn, a new neutral, a look, a pose sheet or a blink sequence.

The supplied untrimmed 768 x 768 RGBA source is the composition and registration reference. Keep the full canvas, the same individual scale, body and head positions, right-facing head/bill angle, neck, folded wings, long pointed tail, feather clusters, black wing spots, cheek mark, warm gray-brown/tan colors, pink legs and both planted feet. Preserve the existing fine naturalistic pixel-art texture. Do not shift, bob, tilt, bend, walk, resize or crop the body, or refit its bounding box. Keep the feet on their exact current pixels: the current192px export has root/pivot (105,150) and inherited toe probes (97,149) and (116,149), corresponding to source (420,600), (388,596) and (464,596). These are existing coordinate notes, not dots or guides to draw.

Close the currently visible open eye with an anatomically plausible fully shut eyelid: a clear narrow curved lid seam following that eye's existing shape, with no open blue/dark iris, pupil or bright catchlight remaining in the closure. Do not merely dim the iris, squint halfway, paint a pupil stripe across an otherwise open eye, rotate the skull or move the bill. Keep the far eye hidden as in the reference; do not invent a second visible eye. Keep the cheek mark and surrounding head feathers consistent. The bird should read as the same calm standing dove making a brief blink, not sleeping with a lowered head.

Preserve the source's existing partial-alpha fringes AND faint warm translucent background field; they are part of this exact registered reference. Do not remove that field, replace the background, clean the matte, threshold alpha, recolor feathers, add scenery, branches, shadows or labels. Preserve existing transparency. The whole native canvas will later be exported to192 x 192 by nearest-neighbor sampling only, at existing world192/density1; no per-pose fitting, snapping, body repair or painting will follow. The exact unchanged existing awake drawing will supply both entry and return. Return ONE RGBA closed-eye drawing only; no additional open or half-closed drawings. Blink timing will be authored later, not inferred as measured biology.
